about.title: A European AI company, sovereign by design.
about.lead: ARACANA AI builds frontier artificial intelligence for the sovereignty of European states and for the expansion of AI across industrial professions, finance and the tasks of everyday life.
missionParagraphs: The most strategic technology of the century should not be something Europe merely rents. We build models that European states and enterprises can own, audit, host and govern entirely on their own infrastructure.
We pair that sovereignty with genuine frontier capability — recursive self-improvement, mechanism-informed multimodal reasoning — kept measurable, reversible and under human control at every step.
And we hold ourselves to a simple test: our work is judged by the value it creates outside the lab, in industry, in finance, and in the everyday.

research.title: Pushing the frontier, under sovereign control.
research.lead: Our research turns three long-horizon bets into the models behind every ARACANA product. One discipline drives everything we train: an explicit, verifiable mathematical model of alignment.
research.approachIntro: An explicit objective function lets our models improve from outcomes; verifiable structure lets them withstand scrutiny beyond average-case performance. Together they make models that are capable, robust and explainable. See how it applies on any product page.
research.loopTitle: How a research bet becomes a shipped model.
research.consistencyCaption: Every candidate is checked against counterfactuals and known constraints before it's trusted — the substance behind "Verifiable Structure" above.
